deskyard shell: interactive login shell

Usage: deskyard [-d NAME] shell

Opens an interactive bash login shell on the desktop in your terminal (raw
mode, resizes follow your window). Exit with `exit` or Ctrl-D. For scripted
use, prefer exec.

Prints: the terminal session

Examples:
  deskyard -d alice shell

Where: on the chosen remote (-d NAME); inside a desktop without a remote it acts locally
Exit codes: the shell's exit code; 1 when it couldn't start
